svg.title: Seven studio bookings on a timeline from 8 to 20
svg.desc: Bars are half-open [start, end). A (9,13), B (10,11), C (12,13), D (12,14), E (15,17), F (16,17), G (17,18) as half-open bars. Live count per hour slot from 8: 0 1 2 1 3 1 0 1 2 1 0 0. Busy blocks [9,14) and [15,18); free gaps (8,9), (14,15), (18,20). B lies inside A; at 17, E and F end and G starts with no clash.
